title: Topographic structure and function of locus coeruleus noradrenaline neurons.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Paper has no PMC full text (the NCBI PMC link 13262244 points to an unrelated J Neurochem review); read the bioRxiv preprint (PMC13082035) instead. Opened the GitHub index repo and capsule repos; the Code Ocean collection page is a JavaScript app, so its data assets were not listed. Listed the NeMO (Neuroscience Multi-omic Archive) directories without logging in. Downloaded the retro-seq cell metadata (Smart-seq v4, samp.dat.Rdata, 395 KB): 1,383 nuclei x 132 columns, with an injection_roi label column. Cross-tabulated the label against donor mouse: every mouse has exactly one injection site (19 mice, 1,307 nuclei pass alignment QC). HEAD checks: retro-seq counts are 19-30 MB; the 10x count matrix is 3.76 GB; DANDI 001950 (recordings) is 385 NWB files, 44.8 GB, open. Read the authors' projection_predict.ipynb: 566 LC-NE cells over 3 targets, test accuracy 0.47-0.55 on a random per-cell split, and near chance when whole mice are held out.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Single-nucleus RNA counts (398,912 nuclei, 4,845 LC-NE (locus coeruleus noradrenaline) neurons, 40 mice), 130-132 reconstructed neurons from 4 brains, 2,221 MERFISH (spatial gene-imaging) cells reused from Nardone et al. 2024, BARseq/MAPseq projection-barcoding data from 2 brains, and the number of recorded units. Not opened: the 10x matrix (3.76 GB), the NWB files and the Code Ocean assets.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked in files: NeMO HTTP directories list and serve files without login, and DANDI 001950 is OPEN. Code Ocean assets were not listable (JavaScript page), but are not needed for the retro-seq task.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked in files: retro-seq metadata has an injection_roi column (MOs;PL cortex, AN;CUL;PRM cerebellum, C5 spinal cord, VAL/VPM thalamus, ml). That is the projection target, stored directly.

a3_inputs_present.note: Checked by file listing only: matching count matrices (CPM, exon and intron sparse Rdata, 19-30 MB) sit next to the metadata. Not opened.

a4_units_stated.note: Counts are labelled by file name (CPM, counts per million; FPKM; raw exon counts). The label is categorical, so no unit is needed.

a5_enough_rows.note: Checked in files: 1,383 nuclei (1,307 pass QC; the paper's model uses 566 LC-NE cells over 3 targets). But each mouse got one injection site, so the real sample size is the mouse: 3 cortex, 3 cerebellum and 5 spinal cord mice (1-5 per site). The authors' own grouped split falls to chance.

a6_fits_laptop.note: The retro-seq set is small. The 10x matrix (3.76 GB) and the recordings (44.8 GB) would only be needed for other tasks.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: 1,383 raw nuclei narrow to the 566 LC-NE cells in the authors' notebook after QC and dropping thalamus. Plausible, but the filter was not rerun.

a8_label_provenance.note: The label is the experimental injection site (where the retrograde virus was placed), a physical fact. It is not a model output and not computed from expression. The paper's 'pseudospace' score in the big 10x set would fail A8, because it is computed from expression.

existing_models.name: Authors' projection-target classifiers (logistic regression, random forest, SVC (support vector classifier), KNN (k-nearest neighbours), gradient boosting) in LCNE_transcriptomics/projection_predict.ipynb
existing_models.score_and_split: Test accuracy 0.47-0.55 across models on a random 60/20/20 per-cell split of 566 cells, 3 classes (chance is about 0.33). With a 3-fold split that holds out whole mice, accuracy falls toward chance.
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Notebook says the projection target is not predictable across animals with the current cohort (3-8 mice per target).

integration.partner_dataset: Allen whole mouse brain taxonomy (ABC atlas) / Nardone 2024 MERFISH
integration.join_key: gene symbol; CCF (Allen Common Coordinate Framework) coordinates
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Not pursued: the rejection rests on too few mice.

controls.positive_control: Dbh/Th/Slc6a2 marker expression separating LC-NE neurons from neighbouring cells.
controls.external_validation: BARseq/MAPseq (in-situ gene readout plus projection barcodes) from 2 brains, in Code Ocean assets that were not opened.

honest_claim_h3: With 1-5 mice per injection site and the label fixed per mouse, a model could only claim to tell apart cells from different mice, not to predict a neuron's projection target from its gene expression.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-nucleus gene expression of brainstem noradrenaline neurons to predict which brain region (cortex, cerebellum, spinal cord) each neuron sends axons to.
plain_idea.train_on: Full-transcriptome counts per nucleus, from retrogradely labelled locus coeruleus neurons; 1,383 nuclei in the file (566 LC-NE cells used by the authors) from 19 mice.
plain_idea.predict: The injection site of the retrograde virus that labelled the neuron, recorded in the injection_roi metadata column.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would show whether projection identity is written in gene expression. But one site per mouse makes mouse and label inseparable, and the authors already report chance-level transfer across mice.

more_or_better_data.why: We would use the same 566 cells the authors' classifiers used; there is no bigger labelled retro-seq set.

confidence_score.why: There are no replicate measurements per cell, and with 1-5 mice per class there are too few groups to estimate uncertainty.

models_beatable.why: The 2026 baselines are simple scikit-learn models, but they already fail on a held-out-mouse split, and the cause is the number of mice, not the model.

guaranteed_improvement.why: No joinable dataset measures the same retrograde label in more mice; BARseq/MAPseq uses a different assay (103-gene in-situ panel) in only 2 brains.

ml_idea: Predict projection target from retro-seq expression. Killed by the mouse-label confound: 1-5 mice per site, and the authors' own held-out-mouse accuracy is at chance.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from file sizes (Rdata 19-30 MB, 566-1,383 cells); nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Cross-tabulate injection_roi against external_donor_name. Done: one site per mouse, 1-5 mice per site, so the project fails.

verdict_reason: A5 in disguise: the open retro-seq data has 1,383 nuclei, but each of its 19 mice got exactly one injection site. That leaves 1-5 mice per projection target, so mouse identity and label can't be separated, and the authors' own held-out-mouse classifier is already at chance. The other modalities are too small (132 reconstructed neurons, 2 BARseq brains), have labels computed from the features (pseudospace), or are 45 GB of recordings with no clean label column.
